main.description: A single transcript segment produced by Murakumo MLX (whisper-large-v3) from a recordingChunk. Text is Signal-encrypted (`signal:v1:`) at write time; server never persists plaintext.

speakerHash.description: sha256(provider participantId + session salt). Not reversible, stable within a session.

textCipher.description: `signal:v1:{ciphertext}` per 10-protocol/wproto signal.ts encryptFieldVal. Recipients = onBehalfOfDid + explicitly granted DIDs.
